sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''King Basilisk: Strength and Fury''' can destroy any hero on the Mission map as long as the [[Litho-Titan]] is in zone 5. Making King Basilisk [[TCG:unblockable|unblockable]] is the best way to move him freely, so allies like [[TCG:SAS-063|Kipperin]] that can give that power to other heroes are awesome. [[TCG:SAS-103|Avoidance]] is an Exhaust Action that makes friendly heroes unblockable for the round, so that's a great combo too.
